title: Thunder Crack
blurb: Close, loud and biblically overstated. This is the atmosphere button. Real thunder is one of the few natural sounds with genuine physical weight to it, and film has spent a century using it to announce that a scene has turned serious. The comedy comes from mismatch: play it behind a villain reveal by all means, but play it behind a terrible pun delivered with total sincerity and it works considerably better. Any statement improves when accompanied by weather. Zeus-certified emphasis, requiring no meteorological justification whatsoever.
origin: A close thunder crack for maximum drama.
